title: : SABBATH EVENING CLASS | Deliverance From Egypt, Then and Now

sense.text:
“Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob. Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin, Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.” All these brothers came into Egypt. That is the actual history of what happened.

But there is the prophecy too, of what Moses said would happen to us in this captivity. The same names that walked into Egypt with our father Jacob are the names that have to be sealed in the last days, and they are in captivity again, in a spiritual Egypt.

precepts.why:
“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again”: notice the word again. It says again because in Exodus 1:1-4 we had walked into Egypt with our father Jacob. Now, when we had just made the exodus and left Egypt, Moses tells us the Lord will bring us into Egypt again, “with ships.”

We did not walk into this one. This Egypt that he is making reference to is a spiritual Egypt.

To find out what Egypt means: “I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.” The first thing you want to look at is that the word Egypt is synonymous with bondage. Egypt is the house of bondage.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”: the great city is Babylon the great, which is symbolism for the United States of America. “Which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt”: that is why Egypt is spiritual.

It is called Sodom: they just passed LGBT laws here; same-sex can get married now; you don’t have to be identified as a gender because you might decide you want to change your gender. This is a spiritual Sodom. And this is not the real Egypt, but America is a spiritual Egypt, where the 12 tribes of Israel were captive.

That is why the one-dollar U.S. currency has the pyramid on the back with the all-seeing eye of Ra, and the bottom of the pyramid says 1776 in Latin, with ‘novus ordo seclorum’, new world order. That is on your dollar bill, for your skeptics out there, you Christians who don’t know a damn thing. That is why there is an obelisk in Central Park in New York City (they call it the eye of Cleopatra) that was actually taken from Egypt and brought to New York, an obelisk in Houston, Texas, and the Washington Monument in Washington, D.C. Why are these symbols of obelisks and pyramids here? Because this is spiritually called Egypt. We walked into the real Egypt; this is another Egypt, a spiritual understanding.

“Where also our Lord was crucified”: our Lord was crucified in Jerusalem. This is a spiritual Jerusalem because the people of Jerusalem are here; we are those people. And his image is crucified in our minds: we don’t want the black image, we don’t want the commandment-keeping image, we want the European no-law Jesus.

“Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees”: the angels were commanded not to hurt the earth, because what is on the earth is armies, and not the sea, because what is on the sea is navies, “till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.”

Who is going to be sealed? “There were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel”: Juda, Reuben, Gad, Aser, Nepthalim, Manasses, Simeon, Levi, Issachar, Zabulon, Joseph and Benjamin, twelve thousand of each.

These are the same names we read in Exodus 1:1-4 that walked into Egypt, and the same names that had to be sealed were in captivity. That is the 12 tribes sign. A lot of people in the Israelite community get upset at this sign.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known.” So we know that the twelve tribes were scattered worldwide.

We are not saying the only Israelites are here in America. The Israelite community is one of the most brain-dead communities you will ever come across, because they don’t think. Do we think that Judah, the American blacks, is only in America? No. Nobody is saying Benjamin is just in those West Indian islands of Jamaica, nobody is saying all of Levi is just in Haiti. We know the tribes are scattered.

One brother from Nigeria was so damn mad: why you got them on the sign? If this makes you mad, you ain’t seen nothing yet, because we got people in India that are waking up, and you ain’t going to change or stop nothing, because the seed of Israel is scattered in all these nations. According to you we’re supposed to read that and ignore it, you dumb stupid Nigerian.

sense.text:
The 12 tribes are scattered worldwide, so why is the sign the way it is? “Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

Listen good to “in the place”. We want to know what this place is. In America they said it: we’re not his people, God’s people. They call us Afro-Americans, African-Americans. So the question is, is that place talking about Jamaica, Haiti, Puerto Rico, Africa? Where is the place where it was said unto them, ye are not my people? The precepts identify it.

precepts.why: The spiritual-minded brothers and sisters will pick up on this: “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.” Which tribe is going to be waking up first? Judah is going to be woken up first.

“And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people.” Bring Judah unto us: Judah would be the one finding all the other 11 tribes. A brother from Colombia said, no, we might be Jews. You didn’t wake up in Colombia until Judah went there and woke your ass. That is what the Lord said: Judah has got to wake his people. They are always trying to disrespect Judah; put some respect on it.

So Judah woke up first, and it was not in Jamaica, not in Haiti, not in Africa; it was here. Somebody might say the Ashanti knew that they were Israel. Well, who did they go out teaching that they were Israel? Nobody. Nigeria, the two tribes among the Yoruba: who did they go out and teach and wake up? Nobody. Judah here in America woke up and said, let’s go out and teach: these are the tribes over here, these are the tribes over there. That is the place where it was said, ye are not my people.

sense.text:
“And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.” Our forefather Joseph had Ephraim and Manasseh in Egypt already.

How does that correlate to today? You get these knuckleheads that say the Puerto Ricans were already in America, already over here in Puerto Rico, and you got the Native Americans on that damn sign that were already here. Yeah, they were already here, just as Joseph was in Egypt already.

precepts.why:
“Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive”: write this down, that was around 722 BC. “And he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land”: that is the region of Assyria.

“But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt.” Some Israelites say the ten tribes woke up one day in slavery and said, let’s leave out of Assyrian captivity. No, that is not what happened. Write this down: 539 BC, King Cyrus, the Persian king, gave the Israelites liberty to return home. That is how they were able to take counsel and say, let’s leave this place. Since when could a slave, a million slaves in slavery, decide we’re leaving? That never happened in history; they had to be given liberty first. So stop listening to the dumb black Israelite community: a lot of them are dumb as a rock. I love them, but they are not put together too tight.

It is just like after slavery ended here: they got so-called freedom, and a lot of slaves migrated from the South to the North, because they were treated a little better in the North, and the majority of the lynching was done in the South. A million didn’t just wake up one day in slavery and say all of us are going north. They got emancipated, liberty, and they migrated up north. That is exactly what happened in the history we are reading about.

“That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land. And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.” The Bible gives you the route the ten tribes of Israel took. The Euphrates goes down into the Indian Ocean; follow it and it takes a route down around Saudi Arabia, down around Africa, and further out that direction is where the United States of America and the so-called Americas are located. Of course they made stops for provisions, for food, whatever they had need for, and they dropped the various tribes off at these areas. Remember, it is millions of people; it is not one boat.

“For the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over. For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half.” Think about it: it took a year and a half to get from that area of Assyria through the Euphrates river into the Indian Ocean, around Saudi Arabia, around Africa, up towards what we call today the Americas. At that time it was called something else: “the same region is called Arsareth.” What we call the Americas our forefathers called Arsareth. This is one of the oldest history books; bet your bottom dollar on this book as opposed to any other book out there.

“Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come, The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest thou the multitude with peace.” What Ezra saw in the vision was about to actually take place.

sense.text:
“And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation. And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied”: we don’t die, we multiply. That has always been the case with us. “And waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.” We outnumbered the Egyptians, just like we outnumber the so-called white man.

In school they teach our kids that we are only 13 percent of the population. That is a lie; we outnumber them ten to one. But to keep the negroes at bay, they let them think they are less than what they actually are. They did a mockery of that in a kids’ movie about ants and grasshoppers: the grasshopper said, do you know these ants outnumber us ten to one? If they gather together they’ll overthrow us, so when one rebels you have to crush them right away. They know that, because that is what happens here in America: if we knew how great our numbers are, and that we are mighty enough, we would overthrow them. But we don’t believe what God says.

“Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” Write this down: a new king means a new kingdom, a new dynasty. That is what they call it, the New Kingdom: a new era of pharaohs came in place. We were in Egypt 400 years; sometimes on TV they make it look like we were there for a year. These are some of the pharaohs that ruled over us, and this is more than just five or six pharaohs.

Our sisters glorify Queen Nefertiti, but she was a slave master. She slaughtered us, she murdered us. Yes, she was good looking, but she was a demon that hated the Israelites. She had hundreds and hundreds of slaves, and their custom was that when a pharaoh died, the slaves were buried with them for the afterlife. Black women will search for any kind of beauty; she has nothing to glorify in, but because she is a black woman, she’s got her head in the sand. Then you got the first female pharaoh: act like a man, talk like a man, the first bull dyke. You got Thutmose the third, and remember he is the third; you got Ramses the second. There were many, over 400 years.

These Egyptians are what they call Nilotes. Write that word down, n-i-l-o-t-e. These are the Hamites, true Hamites. On the continent of Africa there are two categories God specifies, Shemites and Hamites. The Shemites today are called the Bantu tribes; the Hamites are called the Nilotic tribes. We were in Uganda; look at the videos and you can see a clear distinction. That is not to say there is no mixing; there is some mixing in there, so be very careful.

It amazes me when white people think the Egyptians were white. When their scholars say that, they are referring to the Ptolemy dynasty, around 333, when they conquered. The Egyptians were black, they were Nilotic; look at the color on the walls of the Egyptians next to a white woman standing there, red as hell. They have been trying to deceive people.

The pharaoh who brought in monotheism, the belief in one God, got that from the Hebrews, from us. Ramses the second has his sculpture etched in stone: you see how in America they got their four founding fathers on Mount Rushmore? They got that from ancient Egypt, which did the same thing and etched their forefathers’ faces in stone. And the Valley of the Kings is what the Israelites built up.

People look at the pictures of people carrying things to the boats and say, oh, the Egyptians. No. The Israelites, the slaves, were doing the work; the Egyptians didn’t have to lift up nothing. It was not the Egyptians carving out their monumental images; it was the slaves carving out their images.

It was a French Edomite, Jean-François Champollion, who translated the hieroglyphics. They call him the father of Egyptology, and he also deciphered the Rosetta stone. It was not negroes in Harlem in the Kemetic community; they didn’t translate a damn thing. The Kemetic community is one of the dumbest groups you’ll come across: everything they think they got, they got from the white man, and we don’t even know if what he did is correct. Don’t bet your bottom dollar on the white man, because he does lie.
“And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we”: that is the proof.

“Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply”: a lot of times, myself included, when we break this down, we miss what that dealing wisely started first with. Write this down: slavery. That was the first way they dealt wisely with us, meaning wisdom to keep us down.

The same crafty counsel ancient Egypt took against us, they took here with us.

“Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens”: notice they put us in slavery. “And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.” Raamses is located in the Valley of the Kings; these are the images shown earlier.

People say we don’t know who the pharaoh was that Israel made the exodus from under. It is telling you right here, where it says Raamses.

precepts.why:
While they show the excavations in Egypt: “They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search.” One group of them is called archaeologists. That is how you know it ain’t black people: they say black people do a half-assed job on everything; white people don’t do it half-assed, they do a diligent search, they don’t go to sleep till they finish that day’s work. So when they dig up the archives of ancient Egypt, they have been doing a diligent search.

“Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep”: meaning they are deep thinkers. They don’t just think a thought and go nowhere; they have think tanks.

“But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.” These archaeologists dig and get paid millions of dollars, and they are glorified. We glorified the raider of the lost ark, Indiana Jones; he was a thief, he got paid to steal. But let Tyrone steal, and he goes to jail. These archaeologists are nothing but grave robbers, thieves. You saw it in Black Panther, where they had the mask from Africa and Killmonger said to the white woman, how did you get this? You stole it. On TV they make our children glorify stealing: when they do it, it’s okay, it’s called archaeology, a discovery; when we do it, we’re thieves and we ain’t no damn good. They make an agreement with Egypt to go on and do that, to get paid lots of money.

The picture of the ships is what Moses was talking about: “And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.”

“No man shall buy you” means no man shall redeem you from the curses God put us under. You get the NIV, and that German scholar, saying it means people would try to sell themselves as slaves but nobody would buy them. Where in history do you read about a race of people trying to sell themselves, and people going nah? Listen, we’ll give you 400 years of free slave labor, and everybody going nah, we don’t want it? It’s a lie.

There is a picture of a young boy, eight, maybe ten years old, in slavery: this is what happened to the Israelites. When people tell me the Bible is a fairy-tale book: in order to prove the Bible is not real, you first have to disprove that slavery ever existed, and you cannot disprove slavery. There are too many artifacts, too many photos, for it not to be true. That is how we know the Bible is 100 percent true.

The yokes in the pictures are the yokes in this verse: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.”

“Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult”: a tumult is a gathering of nations. “And they that hate thee have lifted up the head”: the enemies of God have lifted up the head as the top of society; they have lifted up the head as God, as Christ and the angels; they have lifted up their head socially and economically.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people”: did y’all miss it? That is Exodus 1:10, “Come on, let us deal wisely with them.” The same thing ancient Egypt did, they did here with us. “And consulted against thy hidden ones”: we are the hidden ones, because the truth that we are the Israelites has been hidden in the earth.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” That is when they changed our identities, our nationalities, our surnames.

And they know it; they put it in their books. ‘Crania Aegyptiaca’, published in 1844, says negroes were numerous in Egypt, but their social position in ancient times was the same that it now is, that of servants and slaves. They are telling you that was the Israelites. ‘The Black Image in the White Mind’, by George M. Fredrickson, is a whole book of arguments about why black people should be kept down as slaves, saying we are inferior and lack the mental stability to run anything. It records that ‘Crania Aegyptiaca’ held that the Egyptians were not negroes, two different races, and that blacks had been relegated to the same servile position in ancient Egypt as in modern America. Boom: they know the same negroes that were in ancient Egypt, the Israelites, are the same negroes here in America. And then they go on with that racist garbage.

‘The Home Tutor’, published in 1862, says the Jews were originally undoubtedly a dark-skinned and woolly-haired race. So these Edomites know who the Israelites are; it has been hidden. And the ‘History of the Jews’, volume four, says Pope Pius V, delighting in persecution, treated Jews as the cursed children of Ham. Even with that, they were letting their own people know to treat these Jews like the cursed seed of Ham. That is how they justified slavery: you’re Hamites, you are the seed of Canaan, so we’re justified in enslaving you. That is why a lot of these white Christians say blacks descend from Ham: because of what Pope Pius V did, treating the Jews as Ham.

To show who the pharaoh was that we made our exodus from: “And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month”, that is Passover, “on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.” Why do you get these dumb Christians that say we’re not certain of the name of the pharaoh? They’re a bunch of liars. They know the name of the pharaoh; the Bible tells you the name of the pharaoh we left from.

“For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.” It doesn’t say heads; it says “upon their gods”, because our people believed some of those Egyptian gods were real. There is no Ra, there is no Seth, there is no Osiris, there is no crocodile-headed one; all that is garbage. Somebody tell the Kemetic community, because they ain’t figured that out yet.

“And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.” It is telling you the name of the pharaoh right there.

sense.text:
“But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel. And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour: and they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.” With rigour: it was hard bondage.

In the books of the pictures of Egypt, chain captives are shown on plaques from a building erected by Ramses II, with yokes of iron around their necks, and notice that they are black. It is the same type of yoke of iron put on a branded slave from Louisiana here; that is why this place is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. That type was for the runaway slave, to make it very difficult to run through the bushes or anywhere. The workers in the vineyard are black: the Egyptians did not have to pick anything from the vineyard, their slaves did. The Israelites are working with the taskmaster over them, the stick in his hand.

In the painting of Tutankhamun, the boy king, shooting his enemies from a war chariot, around the middle of the 18th dynasty, the Israelites are the ones at the bottom right fanning him for his victory, because we were already in slavery; he didn’t have to fight us, like the group on the left, the Jebusites and other Nilotic tribes. At the bottom, the Israelites are the ones loading the ship. As long as you remember the Israelites are the slaves, your mind should be good when you look at these paintings from the 17th and 18th dynasties: the workers are the slaves, and those are the Israelites. The bakers, the ones serving the king food on a platter: the Egyptians didn’t have to serve nobody, we were the servants.

In an old painting of Moses and the Israelites crossing the Red Sea, look at the hand of God at the top, and black Moses: not only is he black, he has an afro on his head. The Israelites are on the left, the Egyptians drowning on the right, and everybody in the painting is black. Christians really need to be ashamed of themselves, every last one of them.

They would steer us away from the Jewish book section in the bookstore, to the African-American section, because of books like this one.

“And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah: and he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him.” From the time of Egypt to America, which is spiritually called Egypt, they have always had an embedded vendetta to kill the young boys. That is why they put ADHD on the young boys and fill the prison houses with us. Their focus is the boys, because the males are the ones that carry the seed of the race, not the women.

This is why they put out movies about interracial marriages: it is all ‘come on, let us deal wisely with them’, separate them from the woman. “But if it be a daughter, then she shall live.” Notice white people say they can deal with the black woman, but they can’t deal with the black man. A lot of these that have been caught murdering black people, you’ll find out, have black girlfriends and say, I’m not racist, look, I got a black girl as a girlfriend, and her simple behind is as simple as hell. Justin Volpe was one.

“But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.” This is what the Lord is trying to rebuild in the minds of the sisters: that Shiphrah and Puah mindset. You don’t get it overnight. That is a special type of sister, a sister with a revolutionary mindset, a mind that loves her race. That is rare, but they are out there; we just have to bring back their memory.

“Therefore God dealt well with the midwives”: God blessed the midwives. “And the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.” Think about it: while we were in captivity in Egypt, Shiphrah and Puah lacked for nothing. They were well taken care of, because they sacrificed their life; they could have been put to death for it. They sacrificed their life for their own people. “And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.”

“And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.” They put out a law to kill all the boys but save the girl children alive. There was a campaign to kill the children: kill the boys.

Today a sister has an abortion of twins and comes looking for sympathy. That is a double homicide. You are murdering your people; there ain’t no sympathy for that. It is called accountability. The American dream is a nightmare. And sisters blame the black man for abortion: well, then why did you lay down with him? Take some responsibility, sister. A female rat will not lay down with a male rat if he ain’t got his own nest, but not our sisters.

Abortion is a nice word for murder, for homicide. What the Egyptians said to do, the black woman is willingly doing today. ‘Abortion: the overlooked tragedy for black Americans’: black women make up 14 percent of the child-bearing population, yet 36 percent of all abortions, and of the over 44 million abortions since the 1973 Roe vs. Wade ruling, 19 million black babies were aborted. Since 1973 black women have murdered 19 million babies, and these same women will point out police brutality. Sisters, I’m talking about the ones unrepented: you shouldn’t be on the street talking about black lives matter; just stay home and fix your wig.

We are still on the first point, slavery in Egypt, then and now. “The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt.” This is thousands of years after Moses and the exodus, so it is talking about another deliverance. The Egypt here is spiritual Egypt, America. The same way we got delivered from ancient Egypt is going to happen in this time period.

A swift cloud is a chariot, what the world calls a UFO.

“And the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence.” This place is full of idols. At the very top of Grand Central Station is Hermes, the Greek messenger god, the god of speed and messages and the god of travelers; the character the Flash was based off of him. All around Grand Central and all through New York City they have Greek and Roman gods. At the library at Grand Army Plaza in Brooklyn they have the prophets on the outside, with the names Jeremiah, Isaiah, Saint Peter written on them, and people come from around the world to see that stuff. All idols.

The sneakers are idols too. The Nike check sign is for Nike, which stands for victory, a Greek god, and that goes back to the Nicolaitans in Revelation. Adidas, another Greek god. People love their Adidas, their Nikes, their Jordans: these are all idols, and you will kill for these idols, murder for these idols. The Washington Monument is an idol, and so is the one with Abraham Lincoln sitting on a chair; people come from all around the world to them. And the main idol is the one they call Jesus Christ: they have these things all over where people come from all around and kiss these damn idols’ feet. The Most High is against all of it.

“And the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.”

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians.” Before the Lord makes this return there is going to be a lot of fighting between Europe and America; the EU is going to turn on the United States of America. Esau is going to be fighting Esau.

“And they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” That is what Christ warned us about, and Ezra wrote the same thing. It is already written, so for you to disbelieve the Bible, there’s something wrong with you.

“And they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.” That is letting you know that America deals with witchcraft. What they call science, God calls witchcraft.

“And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them.” In this chapter Isaiah goes back and forth. The scholars will say this verse is talking about a king of Assyria that smote Egypt after the time of Isaiah, and Isaiah 20 shows that king leading Egypt away. But remember, the scriptures have dual meanings; that is why we went to Isaiah 19. What it says of ancient Egypt, we see happening now.

“And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.” The brooks emptied and dried up, the reeds and flags withered, “every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.” That’s why you see Egypt now, it’s like a desert.

From verse 8 down it goes into the economy of Egypt being at an all-time low: the fishers mourn, “they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish”, they that work in fine flax and weave networks are confounded, “broken in the purposes thereof.” That is letting us know that the economy of America will hit an all-time low.

“Surely the princes of Zoan are fools.” Zoan was one of the major cities of ancient Egypt, so the princes are the leadership in ancient Egypt, and they were fools, just like today. “The counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish”: brutish is stupid.

“How say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?” That is what the leadership here in America does. They say, we’re the sons and daughters of the ancient leaders. There’s a movie that just came out called Them, and in it there is a white girl that gives a rundown to stir all the people in the community up: our ancestors built America, our ancestors are the wise ones. That’s the same thing it’s saying here.

“Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the Lord of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.” God is asking, where are they? Let your wise men tell you what God is going to do to this Egypt. Then and now.

“The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof.” Just like during that time there was a perverse spirit in the midst, so it is today: there’s a perverse spirit throughout America. That is why you got LGBT at an all-time high, and it is going to get worse: transgender, all kind of evil, a perverse spirit in male and female, men and women, boy and girl. “And they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.”

“Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.” The economy is going to be bad. Some think, oh, America, but the Bible says there shall be no work for Egypt. We saw a glimpse of that during the so-called Covid pandemic, when a whole lot of people lost their jobs, and we didn’t see nothing yet.

“In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear.” When it says this place is going to be like women, it means the spirit of fear is going to come throughout this place, “because of the shaking of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shaketh over it.”

“And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt”, because we are going to be prophesying the word of the Lord. In the time of Isaiah, Assyria would ride through the land of Judah into Egypt to attack them. Looking at it again now, the Most High has got his men here telling them what is going to happen.

“Every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts”, because we know the counsel of the Lord of hosts. Just like back then Isaiah was telling them Assyria is going to come through Judah and destroy Egypt, now we’re telling them the Lord is going to come through this place and smite spiritual Egypt, right here in America, which “he hath determined against it.”

precepts.why:
“All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.”

This is the Egyptians set against the Egyptians. America is going to be caught off guard, because like it says in Obadiah, all of America’s allies are going to turn on her. The men that ate bread with her are the ones that lay the wound under her.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore.” Write this down: the ten horns are the European Union, also called the ten common markets. The whore is the United States of America, Babylon the great. They “shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.”

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.” Right now these ten common markets support the United States of America; that is what giving their kingdom unto the beast means, they support this place. But there is going to come a time when they will turn against Babylon.

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” That great city is Babylon the great, the United States of America. That should let you know it’s America right there: what nation rules over the kings of the earth but America?

“City against city, and kingdom against kingdom” is what Christ warned us about: “For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.”

“Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth. And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth. And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.”

That is the deliverance, and the sign of it is the same fighting Isaiah wrote of. When you see nation against nation, kingdom against kingdom, people against people, “the signs shall happen which I shewed thee before”, and then, once you see that happen, “then shall my Son be declared, whom thou sawest as a man ascending.”

So it’s already written. For you to disbelieve the Bible, there’s something wrong with you.

“So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.”

The scholars read the cruel lord of Isaiah 19:4 as one of the kings of Assyria that smote Egypt after the time of Isaiah, and that is what Isaiah goes into here. But the scriptures have dual meanings: what was done to ancient Egypt is what we see happening to spiritual Egypt now.

sense.text: Now point two: repentance in Egypt. “Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian.” Moses is about 80 years old here, and that shows you something about age. You get some old people that say, I’m too old to repent. No, you’re just the old devil, that’s all that is. If Moses can repent at 80 years old, your old ass behind can repent at 82. I’m talking to your grandmama and your granddaddy; get mad if you want. You ain’t never too old to repent. You’re just stubborn and evil.

“And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush.” The angel in the bush is Christ. That’s the God that was in the bush: the angel that followed them, the Rock that followed them, was Christ. So this is Christ speaking to Moses.

“Put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.” Just like we have a custom when you come to someone’s house to take your shoes off, because they don’t want you to track outside filth into the house, whether it’s dirt or doo doo, the Lord told Moses, don’t track that up here.

Track what? Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. Symbolically, take your shoes off means: don’t track none of that Egyptian crap you learned, that you were so mighty in, up here. No Osiris, no Seti, none of that crap up here, Moses. I’m going to teach you all over again, I’m going to guide you the proper way. You got to have the mindset to do my will.

That is what being born again is all about: subdue your own understanding, reform your heart, renew your mind. Forget all that you think you know and start all over again.

precepts.why:
“And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.”

This is what the Lord didn’t want Moses to track onto holy ground. When he said take your shoes off, he meant don’t track none of that Egyptian crap you learned, that you were so mighty in, up here; I’m going to teach you, I’m going to guide you the proper way.

“And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.” Moses left Egypt at 40, then he stayed 40 years in the land of Midian with Jethro. That’s 80 years old right there when the Lord appeared to him, and he still came to the Lord.

“When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him, Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.” That is what we read in Exodus 3.

The angel in the bush is Christ; for the new people, read about it here. “Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea; And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea.” They did all eat the same spiritual meat and drink the same spiritual drink, “for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.”

When it refers to the Rock, it is referring to that God, that angel that followed them, and that was Christ. So the one speaking to Moses out of the bush is Christ.

“Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.”

The Lord told Moses to take his shoes off. Why? Just like we have a custom when you come to someone’s house, you take your shoes off because they don’t want you to track outside filth into the house, whether it’s dirt or doo doo; some of y’all know what I’m talking about. So the Lord told Moses, don’t track that up here. And what he didn’t want tracked is in verse 22: all the wisdom of the Egyptians.

King Solomon says the same thing. You start showing people the truth, the gospel, and they want to track their Egyptian garbage in. “Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools.” Be more ready to hear when you enter the house of God than to give the sacrifice of fools, to talk BS because you got something to say. You’re an idiot, be quiet.

“For they consider not that they do evil.” People don’t consider that it’s evil, when the word of God is coming out, to track their Egyptian garbage into the house of the Lord. This is famous with Christians: you bring out the gospel, that the good news is for our people, and here comes a Christian to track the Egyptian garbage in: no, no, Jesus is white and he came for all people. They don’t consider that they’re doing evil.

“Be not rash with thy mouth.” That’s how Christians are, very rash with their mouth; they want to interrupt the Bible and talk over the Bible, and they say the most evil things you can’t imagine. “And let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God”: a Christian is quick to utter anything; if it feels right they just say it, and it’s just as evil and wrong as ever. “For God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.” A Christian don’t understand that.

So the Most High told Moses to take his shoes off up there: I don’t want you to track no Osiris or Seti up here.

It’s the same mindset, the same thing God is saying in the New Testament. “And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.” Our people don’t understand that you cannot come to Christ with the old mindset; you’re not going to learn anything.

“That ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.” You must know what the perfect will is, what God expects of you. The Christian church did not tell us that. They said come as you are, the Lord knows your heart. No: he said your mind must be changed.

“Therefore if so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts.” Ezra is saying the same thing just read in Romans 12:2. Subdue your own understanding: that’s what God told Moses. Reform your heart means transform your mind. Forget all that you think you know, forget about it, and start all over again. That is what being born again is all about, being renewed in your mind.

“Ye shall be kept alive and after death ye shall obtain mercy.” After the death of your body you shall obtain mercy, meaning everlasting life.

“Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.” To be born again means to subdue your own understanding and reform your heart: change your mind.

That goes for the women too. The world says men and women are 50 50; that is not what God says. Unless we subdue our own understanding and reform our hearts we will not be saved, male or female. You get sisters that come and say, Bishop, can you tell him to wash the dishes? He is your lord, I’m not your lord. A sister asked during Passover, can you show me what it looks like to be submissive? Just read the Bible. The issue is you’re reading it and the demon in you is going, that means slavery. A lot of women like that here in America are not going to make it, because they are reading the Bible with that white man in their mind.

The movie Them shows how it is done. Satan says to a white preacher, this people is a cursed people, you got to kill them, but the way to destroy them is from within; you got to break them from within. And sure enough you have a little black girl, about 14 or 15, dipping her hand in white paint because she wants to be a white girl, putting in blue contacts, wanting to be a cheerleader; the husband is broken, the wife is broken, the kids are broken, the whole black family destroyed. The mama perms the little girl’s hair and the girl asks, do I look pretty now, mama? What is going on in the black woman’s head is that she wants to be just like the oppressor, because of what she lets into her mind. Get rid of them white magazines; put them in the garbage.

What they put on the television, in the commercials, the magazines and the movies, is uploaded into the mind, and it builds in you and your children that the oppressor is the one that is beautiful and powerful and you are not. Without the Bible you just soak it all up; with the Bible you can step outside of it and see what message they’re putting out.

“And be renewed in the spirit of your mind.” We have got to be renewed in the spirit of our minds.

sense.text: “If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy”: this is spiritual Egypt right here. We sinned, the Lord was angry, and he delivered us to the enemy, “far or near”.

“Yet if they shall bethink themselves”: to bethink yourself means to remember. It deals with the mind. Remember who you are. Renew your mind, transform your mind, subdue your own understanding. You think you’re Afro-American, or African-American, or whatever, Jamaican or Haitian? You better subdue your own understanding. That is what it is saying.

“In the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned”: this is what the Lord wants to hear us say. We have to admit we have broken God’s commandments, because that is what sin means: Lord, we have broken your commandments.

“And have done perversely.” When you send up prayers, be specific. The word sin is very vague, and saying you broke the commandments is vague. When you are praying to the Lord (not talking with brothers and sisters, everybody need to mind their business on that end), say what you are sorry for, what perversity you have committed. Was it abortion? Then tell the Lord you’re sorry for abortion. Same-sex relations, drug addiction, hatred against your neighbor, child abuse: whatever it is, and it could be a myriad of things, you go to the Lord and pray to him about those things, and it is nobody else’s business.

You don’t need to sit in council for two hours talking about what happened to you when you were eight. Just pray to the Lord; you’ve got to get healed from that stuff. And some think white man therapy is going to help them: lay on his couch, pay a hundred dollars an hour, do the same talking you’re doing here, feel better, and that’ll be 500, ma’am. The white man can’t help you on your issues. You can lay on your own couch and talk to yourself.

“In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan”: there is a lot of discussion on this verse. When you examine the language of Canaan it goes into Hebrew, but it ain’t talking about speaking Hebrew. The language of Canaan it is talking about is the Bible, the word of God.

We were entering Canaan when the tribes made that oath in Joshua 22, an oath to the Lord and amongst ourselves never to forget the children of Israel, who our brethren were. So to speak the language of Canaan is to speak the word of God, and to “swear to the Lord of hosts”.

“In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord”: it goes back to the altar built in Joshua 22, and the altar deals with the priesthood. “In the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord”: the pillar deals with a leader or a king. So the altar and the pillar are the priesthood and the kingship.

“And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt”: that is what we read in Joshua, the altar that was a witness that we would never forget the tribes of Israel, our brethren. This also goes into not forgetting your brothers, your nation, your kin, your people.

Right now the witness is this word, this Bible. The altar and the pillar are back, meaning the kingship and the priesthood are coming back, and now we are speaking the language of Canaan, the word of God. The land of Egypt is America.

“For they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors”: all of us are crying to the Lord because of this white man. He is the oppressor Isaiah is prophesying about. When we teach, we are crying unto the Lord because of the oppressor.

“And he shall send them a saviour”: that saviour is Christ, the Messiah, “and a great one, and he shall deliver them.” Verse 20 goes back to verse 1 that was read at the beginning.

precepts.why:
“Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel”: listen good. “The Lord God of gods, the Lord God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, (save us not this day,) That we have built us an altar to turn from following the Lord”, or to offer burnt offering, meat offering or peace offerings thereon, “let the Lord himself require it”. They built it “for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the Lord God of Israel?”

The tribe of Reuben, Gad and half Manasseh had their lands on the opposite side of Jordan from the other tribes of Israel. The issue was that a day might come when the rest would forget that Gad, Reuben and half Manasseh were their people: “For the Lord hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the Lord: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the Lord.” Our kids might say to your kids, you have no part in the Lord.

“Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us”, “that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the Lord.” So they built an altar there, so that for all generations Israel would always remember that Gad, Reuben and half Manasseh were Israelites, though they were on the other side of Jordan. They had this oath between them.

That oath, made as Israel entered Canaan, is the language of Canaan in Isaiah 19:18; that altar is the altar of Isaiah 19:19; and that witness is the witness of Isaiah 19:20: never forget the tribes of Israel, our brethren.

sense.text: This is the third point: deliverance from Egypt. “Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt”: that day is not yet. We are still talking about the deliverance from ancient Egypt under the hand of Moses. So when people say we’re not supposed to be celebrating Passover, no: it is telling you we will be celebrating Passover now.

“But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north”: the land of the north is North America. North America, the United States of America, is Babylon the great. It is prophetic. This will be spoken about and celebrated on the other side, when we are delivered up out of here.

“And from all the lands whither he had driven them”: all the various lands and countries, whether it’s Jamaica, Haiti, Santo Domingo, Puerto Rico, Brazil, Central and South America, Africa, India, Afghanistan, Pakistan. All these lands we are gathered from, we are going to celebrate then. He focused on the land of the north because the big deliverance is going to come from America, then the rest of the lands where we’ve been scattered.

“And I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers”: that is the land of Canaan, that is Israel.

“Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them”: right now he is calling for many fishers, and that is what we are doing now, fishing. Christ said to pray for laborers, for the harvest is plentiful but the laborers are few. No matter how big we get, we still don’t have enough to gather the great multitude, as the sand of the sea. We ain’t got time for arguing with Israelites.

“And after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks”: after the fishing time we are going to be turned into soldiers and warriors, real warriors, and sent forth as hunters. And our people that join with other nations, we’re going to hunt them too. They’re going to be put down, read between the lines, because they are going to stand on the side of Moab and Ammon and the Jebusites. The line is drawn in the sand and they crossed the line.

Right now we are just fishing; we ain’t going to do nothing. But when the Lord gives us that power and changes the fishers into hunters (in order to become a hunter you have to have power), that is when the grace time is finished. There is no more opportunity to repent. You had your opportunity; now you’re finished.

precepts.why: This goes with Deuteronomy 33, read earlier, verse 7: “Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people.” Judah would be fishing, bringing his people in, and the tribes that join with Judah would be fishers. That is what Jeremiah 16:16 is saying: “I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them.”

sense.text:
“Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him”: that is what we are doing now. When we are fishing for brothers and sisters, we are standing in great boldness against the man who has afflicted us. This so-called white man is the oppressor, he’s the afflicter, and it is great boldness to say the things we say on the street. We teach brothers and sisters, this is the man that has afflicted us, enslaved us, oppressed us and colonized us, and here comes a Christian with John 3:16 and Galatians 3:28. It never fails.

They say it’s hate speech. Just saying the white man is an oppressor is translated as hate speech; just saying God is black, that Jesus is black, is hate speech. They took a post down off Instagram calling it hate: Christians today, ‘hi, I’m Galatians 3:28, my name is John 3:16’. That is modern day Christianity, how our people are coons and vagabonds. Anytime we try to speak and let our people know the truth, everything we put up is hate speech. These oppressors think they can put fear upon us, but the Bible says we’re going to speak with great boldness. So lift up your voice in the street knowing the angels are around you. You can speak now; speak like a man. We’ve been commanded to speak boldly.

“And made no account of his labours”: 400 years of free slave labor, no account. Reparations? Please. Y’all ain’t getting nothing.

“When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear”: believe it or not, a lot of our people join with the oppressor. These are the negroes and the Latinos that join with the white man. They are going to see it, because they disregarded everything we’ve been teaching them. “And shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for”: they are going to be amazed at the strangeness of our salvation. How so? Revelation 11 shows it.

“And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach: We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour: How is he numbered among the children of God, and his lot is among the saints!”

Our people that join with the white man, and a lot of these Christian pastors too, are going to be saying that same thing, because they so trusted their oppressor, loved him so much. They thought the Israelites were crazy.

precepts.why:
Revelation 11 was read earlier, but not the main point. “And after three days and an half”: 350 years. “The Spirit of life from God entered into them”: the Holy Spirit entered into us; we realized we’re the Israelites and must keep the commandments. “And they stood upon their feet”: we stood upon our feet as the 12 tribes of Israel. “And great fear fell upon them which saw them”: what the nations see is fear, because they know what is going to happen.

“And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither”: there’s the salvation, the strangeness. This is what the church calls the rapture: a great voice that says come up hither. “And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud”: a cloud which is a chariot of God. “And their enemies beheld them.”

This is the same thing Wisdom of Solomon 5:2 is saying: the enemies troubled with terrible fear, amazed at the strangeness of his salvation.

Matthew 24:30 says the same thing: “And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn”, all the tribes going to cry, “and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven”: we are going to see the King of kings and Lord of lords, “with power and great glory.”

“And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” This is the same thing Wisdom of Solomon 5 is saying, the same thing as Revelation 11:11-12.

sense.text: Watch this part, for you John 3:16 people out there. “So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous”: yeah, they accept that part of the Bible. “And destruction of the enemies”: I don’t know about that part right there, John 3:16 says. What about John 3:16, my brother? The Bible says you have to accept both, the salvation of the righteous and the destruction of the enemies. That is what it done said. You get people who say they don’t accept it; then you ain’t gonna make it. Goodbye.

precepts.why:
Go to ancient Egypt, the ransom. Israel couldn’t say, oh, we don’t want Egypt destroyed. Those Israelites that thought like that got put to death.

“But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name”: the Lord tells us fear not. “Thou art mine.”

“When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee”: he is reminding us of when we came through the rivers with Moses. This is way after Moses, but he is letting us know this is another deliverance.

“When thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned”: that goes with Psalms 91, a thousand falling at thy left hand and ten thousand at thy right, and it shall not come near thee. That is the destruction, the destruction of the enemies we have to accept, and it is what John the Baptist prophesied about Christ.

sense.text:
“I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance”: John baptized with water unto repentance. “But he that cometh after me is mightier than I”: the one coming after him is way mightier than him, “whose shoes I am not worthy to bear”; he is not worthy to touch his shoes. “He shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost”: see if he says Christ will baptize with water too. Christ ain’t gonna baptize with no water; he is going to baptize you with the Holy Ghost, that’s the spirit.

So how come later on in the book of Acts they were baptized with water? That was on the decline. That is why Paul said Christ sent him not to baptize, and he thanked God he baptized none of them but one, two or three. So where did the water come back from? The Roman Catholic Church in Spain said we had to be baptized with water to become part of their antichrist church, and that is how water baptism escalated all over again. That is why you hear some of y’all asking, can you baptize me with some water. You won’t find a scripture with Christ dipping anybody in water, not one verse.

The Son of God would baptize with the Holy Ghost, so why the hell are people bringing back water, going back to John? That was on the decline. John the Baptist said he must decrease but this man, Christ, must increase: his ministry increases and John’s decreases. People ain’t figuring that out yet.

“And with fire”: he explains what that fire is in the next part.

“Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner”: meaning gather his elect into the chariots. “But he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire”: thermonuclear fire. John the Baptist prophesied that. In a nutshell he is saying Christ ain’t using the water; he is going to baptize you with the Holy Ghost, then he is going to destroy all the wicked. People don’t want to hear that part. They want water: water, water, baptize me.

precepts.why:
From Matthew to the book of Peter, Peter tells you something. “The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us”: Peter says baptism does save us. Is he talking about John’s baptism of water, or Christ’s baptism of the Holy Spirit?

“Not the putting away of the filth of the flesh”: not water, because water is what takes away the filth, and that cannot save. Water ain’t gonna do nothing but clean your body. That type of baptism, of water, don’t save nobody. “But the answer of a good conscience toward God”: that’s the Holy Ghost. “By the resurrection of Jesus Christ”: by believing the resurrection of Jesus Christ. That is what saves you, not water. Peter made it clear, so case closed.

Then hundreds of years later, a thousand years later, the Roman Catholic Church said, here are these Israelites, these Jews, we need to get them into the Catholic Church: baptism or slavery, you decide. Some of our people said baptize me, master, and joined the Catholic Church. The other half said I’m not joining that, and went into slavery. And by the end of it even the ones baptized with water went into slavery too. That is the Inquisition, history 101. And here we are, everybody asking about baptism, and they brought it right back again. That was fine for the time of John up until Acts, and Peter cleared it up: that is not what saves you.

You’ll find the most wicked people with water baptism, because with water baptism you ain’t got to do nothing: you just dip in water and you’re good in Jesus. But when you get baptized with the Holy Ghost, you must keep the commandments.

Christ told us that about the Holy Ghost. “If ye love me, keep my commandments. And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever; Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you. I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.” And verse 19: “Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.”

The stipulation for receiving the Comforter, which is the Holy Spirit, the Holy Ghost, is the same thing: if you love me, keep my commandments. And he says “I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.” So Christ is telling you who the Comforter is. It is not Mohammed. Christ is the Comforter; he’s the Holy Ghost.

So when John says one coming after him will baptize with the Holy Ghost, it is Christ, and that baptism comes with keeping the commandments, not with water.

sense.text: “And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them”: that saviour, that great one, is Christ the deliverer.

“And the Lord shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord”: you might be confused. What do you mean the Egyptians shall know the Lord? Is the Lord going to save Egypt? No, that’s not what he’s saying. Just like here in America we call ourselves Americans, when we were in Egypt we were saying we Egyptians. In that day it is talking about the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah.

“And shall do sacrifice and oblation”: what sacrifice are we going to do? Passover is a sacrifice. We are still going to commemorate the Passover. “Yea, they shall vow a vow unto the Lord, and perform it.”

“And the Lord shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it”: the ones he is going to smite are all those wicked Israelites that are here, and the ones he is going to heal are the repentant Israelites. “And they shall return even to the Lord”: return. The real Egyptians were never with the Lord. This is a key right there, letting you know that what Isaiah 11:11 said is correct. “And he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.”

“In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria”: the Assyrian captivity was the northern captivity, the northern kingdom, and they were brought under Babylon, and all of us came here. The highway out of Egypt means deliverance. “And the Assyrian shall come into Egypt”: the Assyrian means the northern kingdom coming into Egypt; that is still dealing with our people in Egypt. “And the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians”: we all together, as Jeremiah 50 says.

“In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land”: we are going to remember who we are. That is why Isaiah 11 mentioned Assyria first and Egypt second: those are the two major captivities.

“Whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people”: letting you know this is Israel. “And Assyria the work of my hands”: that is still the Israelites, the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah. “And Israel mine inheritance”: we are all going to repent and become Israel once again.

precepts.why: Read verse 1 again to see it: “The burden of Egypt.” The Lord “shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.” The Lord is coming. He is going to deliver us and destroy the oppressor. That is the saviour and the great one of verse 20.

“And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt”: from Egypt, “and from Pathros”, of Egypt as well, “and from Cush”, that’s Ethiopia, “and from Elam”, that’s India, “and from Shinar”, that’s Iraq, “and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.”

“And he shall set up an ensign for the nations”: see who these people are. “And shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.”

So the Egypt the Lord recovers his remnant from is where Israel is. When Isaiah 19:21 says the Egyptians shall know the Lord, it is talking about the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah, who called themselves Egyptians in Egypt just as we call ourselves Americans here.

The Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians: we all together, as Jeremiah 50:33 says. “Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.”

“Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.” The northern kingdom and Judah, oppressed together in captivity, are the Assyrian and the Egyptian serving together in Isaiah 19:23, and the Lord is their redeemer out of it.
